personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (adapted with regional blue-and-white mobility tone)
personality_one_liner: Transporte, Turismo e Entregas na palma da sua mão — professional, intuitive, and designed for all ages in Belmonte, Bahia.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical padding, comfortable touch targets, crystal-clear grouping for regional users with varying digital experience.

do's: Use frosted glass on floating headers and sticky ride-status banners
Apply subtle backdrop blur on bottom action sheets
dont's: Do not blur dense form fields or body text regions

screens.name: HomeClient
screens.purpose: Main client dashboard featuring regional service grid (Transporte, Turismo, Encomendas, Viagens, Agendar), active ride tracker banner, and quick WhatsApp support.

states.loading: Centered blue spinner with Belmonte Mobi logo
states.empty: Clean promotional banner with start booking CTA
states.error: Friendly alert banner with retry button

screens.layout: Header with current location badge in Belmonte BA, live status pill, service grid in 2 columns, recent destinations list, sticky WhatsApp button and bottom navigation.

screens.name: RideBooking
screens.purpose: Request passenger transport or private travel with real-time price estimation, vehicle class selector, and driver matching.

states.empty: No drivers available in immediate radius, expand search
states.error: Failed to calculate route or connect to server

screens.layout: Interactive map view on top half, bottom sheet with pickup/dropoff inputs, vehicle category cards, price estimate, and sticky confirm button.

screens.name: LiveTracking
screens.purpose: Real-time trip status tracking across 6 milestones (Procurando motorista -> Encontrado -> A caminho -> Chegou -> Em andamento -> Concluída).
screens.layout: Full screen map with driver route, floating status card with driver details (photo, vehicle, rating), call/chat actions, and cancel/complete buttons.

screens.name: TourismCatalog
screens.purpose: Discover and book regional tours, boat trips on Jequitinhonha river, and historical sightseeing in Belmonte.

states.empty: No tours listed for this season

screens.layout: Category filter chips, horizontal featured carousel, vertical list of tour cards with imagery, price, duration, and instant booking modal.

screens.name: ParcelDelivery
screens.purpose: Send packages and small freights with tracking code generation and recipient details.
screens.layout: Sender & receiver address form, package size selector, estimated weight, photo upload, and instant tracking status viewer.

screens.name: DriverPanel
screens.purpose: Driver operational hub with online/offline toggle, incoming service requests queue, earnings summary, and job management.

states.empty: You are offline. Turn on to receive regional requests.

screens.layout: Top online/offline switch banner, today's earnings card, incoming request alert modal with countdown timer, active job card with navigation links.

screens.name: AdminDashboard
screens.purpose: Comprehensive administration panel for monitoring regional metrics, approving drivers, managing pricing, commissions, and users.

states.empty: No pending approvals or active logs

screens.layout: Tabbed management interface (Dashboard metrics, Drivers pending verification, Pricing & Commission config, User management, Reports).

belmonte_hero.alt: Belmonte Bahia coastal landscape with palm trees and blue ocean

instructions_to_main_agent: Design specifically for Belmonte Mobi - regional transport, tourism, and delivery platform for Belmonte, Bahia, Brazil.
Strictly follow the user's choice of blue-and-white visual identity with discreet accents.
Keep interfaces simple, fast, professional, and extremely accessible for users with varying digital experience.
Implement all three user profiles: CLIENTE, MOTORISTA, and ADMINISTRADOR with clear switching or dedicated tabs.
Include real-time ride tracking with 6 distinct status milestones, parcel tracking by code, tourism catalog, and WhatsApp support button.
Ensure touch targets are >= 44x44pt and enforce the sticky primary CTA pattern on booking and form screens.
